newsitem.title: RUSSIA: GAZ starts car assembly in Ukraine.
newsitem.headline: GAZ starts car assembly in Ukraine.

text.p: Russian carmaker GAZ has started assembling its GAZ-31029 Volga saloon in Simferopol in Ukraine's Crimea peninsula, GAZ said on Tuesday.
GAZ's KrymavtoGAZservis subsidiary intends to assemble 60 cars in March, rising to 150 a month from May, it said in a statement.
AO Gorkovsky Avtomobilny Zavod (GAZ) is already assembling its GAZel light trucks in Crimea, producing 2,000 vehicles there in 1996.
Assembling Volga saloons in Crimea is six percent cheaper than at GAZ's home plant in Nizhny Novgorod, it said.
GAZ's total vehicle output rose to 34,521 in the first two months of this year from 32,033 in the same 1996 period.
